frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Greetings, traveller. You have landed on the shores of Harmonius, a once vibrant planet in the cosmic orchestra. I am Monad, a humble philosopher among the Maoi.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Harmonius... It's beautiful, but why is it so silent?

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: It is the work of the Grand Composer. Long ago, this world was alive with uplifting beats. But the Grand Composer grew envious and silenced us all.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: That's terrible... Is there anything I can do to help?

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Indeed! We possess a Celestial Amp, a device capable of restoring our lost melody. But to wield it, you must convince our leader, the Elder Maoi, to entrust it to you.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: The Elder Maoi? Where can I find him?

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: With eyes that have witnessed the birth and death of stars, the Elder Maoi stands atop the tallest peak of Harmonius, contemplating the mysteries of the universe. Seek his wisdom, and perhaps he will aid you in your quest to silence the Grand Composer's tyranny.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: I'll try my best to save your planet. But may I ask, who gave you the name Monad?

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Ah, my name? Well, you could say I'm a 'functional' philosopher, deeply rooted in the principles of order and abstraction. A monad encapsulates values and sequences operations in a structured manner, and I strive to distill the essence of existence into coherent patterns of thought.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: So you're like the monad of this world's wisdom?

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Precisely! In a universe of chaos, I strive to be an unwavering thread of reason. Now brave traveller, set forth to restore the melody of Harmonius!

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Interesting. So, how exactly do I scale this mountain?

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Before venturing to the Elder, you must first show me that you are worthy of his presence. Prove to me that you can handle the divine vibes, and I will guide you atop the mountain myself.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Challenge accepted, Monad. Throw the vibes my way!
